memory_bridge: Under the market awning, a 市民 badge gives formal On シ, while the old-fashioned market call 市場 starts with native Kun いち.

readings.editorial_reason: Promoted because 市民（しみん）is common, modern, and pedagogically useful.
readings.overlay: Give a shopper beneath the cloth awning a 市民（しみん） badge; the first character’s On シ identifies a “citizen.”

readings.editorial_reason: Promoted because 市場（いちば）is common, modern, and pedagogically useful.
readings.overlay: Have the vendor open the town 市場（いちば） and call the first character いち; that complete market word fixes Kun いち.
